mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, actor_user_id AS actor_id, event_type, event_reason AS reason, new_handler_user_id, created_at FROM t_product_feedback_event WHERE ((new_handler_user_id = #{user} AND actor_user_id <> #{user}) OR event_type IN ('SUBMITTED_FOR_ACCEPTANCE', 'ACCEPTANCE_REJECTED')) AND id < #{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
